name: Residencia Legal Temporaria -- Trabajo

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a letter from the Uruguayan employer (on letterhead) stating position, contract duration, and monthly salary, notarially verified, plus BPS (social security) employment history.
Requires a monthly salary at or above Uruguay's national minimum wage (Salario Mínimo Nacional).

evidence_required.document: Criminal record certificate (country of birth and any country of 6+ months residence in the past 5 years)
Current vaccination certificate and health record
Employer letter and notarial/BPS verification of employment

outcome.duration_length: 6 months to 2 years, renewable for equal periods

sources.title: Sitio oficial de la República Oriental del Uruguay -- Residencia Legal Temporaria: worker/student/religious categories, minimum-wage salary threshold, 6mo-2yr duration

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Uruguay's initial build. This is Uruguay's general (non-MERCOSUR) temporary residency trámite, confirmed directly at tier-1, modelled here as the WORKER-purpose category specifically since Uruguay's own page bundles worker/student/religious under one trámite with different evidence per activity type -- the schema's one-category-per-route design means these are split into separate files by category (see uy_temporary_residency_student) rather than merged, even though they share a single government process. Uruguay's minimum wage is a periodically-updated indexed figure (not a fixed USD amount) -- modelled with a placeholder 'SMN' currency unit and unit 'month' rather than a converted dollar figure, since a snapshot conversion would go stale and mislead; the source itself states the requirement as 'at least one national minimum wage', not a dollar amount. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the 5-year without-family track under uy_naturalisation, since this worker route alone does not establish 'family constituted' status.
